layer_rule: UI -> Application Service -> Domain policy -> Ports -> Adapters. UI and Orchestrator must never hold a SQLite handle, issue SQL, infer authorization, or write state directly.

application_services.name: CaptureApplicationService
application_services.responsibility: Validate a capture request, persist an immutable Artifact/record through a port, create minimal audit/outbox facts atomically, and return a receipt.
application_services.fast_track: adapt existing capture_record behavior without expanding raw path or SQL input

application_services.name: ContextRecoveryApplicationService
application_services.responsibility: Resolve a Project-backed Context, load authorized related evidence/Decision/Action/Event projections, and return current state, next, recent, evidence gaps, and provenance refs.

application_services.name: ContextAssociationApplicationService
application_services.responsibility: Apply explicit user confirmation of a proposed capture-to-existing-Project Context link, record Feedback/Audit, and never create a Context silently.
application_services.fast_track: one explicit confirmation mutation, restricted to a preseeded synthetic Project-backed Context

application_services.name: MemoryQueryApplicationService
application_services.responsibility: Project authorized core objects into a MemoryItem/detail with provenance and stale/evidence-gap semantics.
application_services.fast_track: read-only detail for the same single Context; no generic search, FTS, or source ingestion

application_services.name: GlobalAiContextResolver
application_services.responsibility: Assemble inspectable, removable, reauthorized request context for a future Model/Agent call.
application_services.fast_track: preview-only; no ModelPort or AgentPort invocation

ports.name: CaptureRepository
ports.contract: returns domain DTOs; no SQL, filesystem path, or opaque DB handle crosses the port

ports.name: ProjectRepository
ports.contract: Project remains the authoritative backing object for context_type=project

ports.name: ContextProjectionRepository
ports.contract: returns a composed projection and typed refs, not a new Context core entity

ports.name: MemoryReadPort
ports.contract: returns provenance links and current availability; never materializes a second original-content authority

ports.name: AuthorizationPort
ports.contract: deny-first, six dimensions, current state/generation/evidence checks

ports.name: FeedbackRepository
ports.contract: append-only; confirmation effect is computed, not overwritten

ports.name: AuditPort
ports.contract: minimum scoped metadata; no body/path/model prompt dumping

ports.name: DomainEventPort
ports.contract: event cannot publish if transaction does not commit

ports.name: ModelPort
ports.contract: future only; Model never receives unaudited/unapproved refs or direct repository access

ports.name: AgentPort
ports.contract: future only; Agent remains separate from Model and requires explicit capability/authorization

transaction_and_event_boundary.write: One application service owns one transaction: validate current authorization/generation -> append capture/link/Feedback/Audit -> commit -> publish domain event or outbox record. A failure yields no receipt and no event.
transaction_and_event_boundary.read: Application service asks repository/read model for candidates -> AuthorizationPort rechecks every returned reference -> constructs response with evidence gaps -> UI renders only that DTO.
